summary: IDF forces in the Beaufort and Litani areas seized over 340 weapons and destroyed a tunnel shaft in a civilian home, while Israeli artillery shelled Mifdon in Lebanon. In Gaza, IDF strikes killed one Palestinian and wounded others in Al-Zawayda and Nuseirat. Iran conducted ballistic missile tests from Sanandaj and Parand, and the White House is seriously considering renewed military strikes against Iran.

Iran conducted a missile test launch in Parand, Tehran Province. (Source: @shin_persian/12031)

South Korea expanding Cheonghae Unit mission to Oman coast, adding P-8A Poseidon and mine countermeasures. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9602)

sections.executive_summary: IDF forces in the Beaufort and Litani areas seized over 340 weapons and destroyed a tunnel shaft in a civilian home, while Israeli artillery shelled Mifdon in Lebanon. In Gaza, IDF strikes killed one Palestinian and wounded others in Al-Zawayda and Nuseirat. Iran conducted ballistic missile tests from Sanandaj and Parand, and the White House is seriously considering renewed military strikes against Iran.

points: Iranian state media staged a symbolic execution of a Trump effigy in Tehran's Tajrish Square after days of displaying the caged figure. (Source: @shin_persian/12024)
A UAV was launched from Omidiyeh in Khuzestan Province, indicating ongoing drone operations. (Source: @shin_persian/12023)
Iran conducted a missile test launch in Parand, Tehran Province, as part of its missile development program. (Source: @shin_persian/12031)
A ballistic missile test was launched from Sanandaj in Kurdistan Province at 0650Z (10:20 local time). (Source: @shin_persian/12028)
Iran's Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei delivered a letter from Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei to Russian President Putin. (Source: @N12chat/233594)
The IRGC ground forces commander visited three Iranian islands to demonstrate freedom of navigation in Persian Gulf waters. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9615)

OFAC sanctioned an India-based network led by Suniel Kumar Sharma and Jaspreet Preeti Shahid for providing false flags and certifications to Iran's shadow fleet, and a Turkey-based company for servicing sanctioned Iranian airlines. (Source: @shin_persian/12017)
IDF forces operating in the Beaufort and Litani area seized more than 340 weapons and destroyed a subterranean tunnel shaft inside a civilian residence. (Source: @yediotnews25/137363)
Israeli artillery conducted shelling on the Lebanese village of Mifdon. (Source: @redlinkleb/51860)
Israeli airstrikes in central Gaza's Al-Zawayda area and Nuseirat refugee camp killed one Palestinian and wounded several others. (Source: @yediotnews25/137359)
Israel has approximately $10 billion in outstanding orders for US military equipment not covered by existing aid commitments through 2028. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9613)
Former President Trump considered launching strikes on Iran before the midterms at Netanyahu's urging, according to Axios. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9606)
CIA Director Ratcliffe and Treasury Secretary Bessent advise letting the naval blockade and economic pressure campaign against Iran continue longer. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9610)
Palestinian reports indicate one killed and multiple wounded in IDF strikes on Al-Zawayda and Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza. (Source: @yediotnews25/137359)
Ra'am party leader Mansour Abbas declared support for Trump's Gaza plan and the disarmament of Hamas during presidential consultations. (Source: @yediotnews25/137353)

Lebanese monitoring recorded 124 alerts on November 4, including 80 drone sightings, one drone strike on Qabrikha, five airstrikes on Tlousa, Aita al-Jabal, Wadi al-Hujeir, and Kfar Tibnit, and ten artillery shelling incidents across multiple villages. (Source: @redlinkleb/51813)
A hostile aircraft dropped three sound bombs between the towns of Zoutar al-Sharqiya and Zoutar al-Gharbiya. (Source: @redlinkleb/51856)
Additional sound bomb dropped between Zoutar al-Sharqiya and Zoutar al-Gharbiya. (Source: @redlinkleb/51851)
Fire sweeping operations reported in the areas of Al-Bayyada and Sarbin. (Source: @redlinkleb/51855)
Israeli artillery shelled the village of Mifdon. (Source: @redlinkleb/51860)
French ISIS member Thomas Barnouin, detained since the Iraqi insurgency, pleaded guilty to ISIS membership in a Baghdad court and expressed regret. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9618)

South Korea decided to expand the Cheonghae Unit's mission area to the southern coast of Oman, increasing personnel from 320 to 395 and doubling the mission area to include waters near the Port of Duqm, adding a P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft, EOD teams, and unmanned mine countermeasures equipment. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9602)
UKMTO issued Warning 196-26 for maritime security in the region. (Source: @shin_persian/12029)
IRGC ground forces commander visited three Iranian islands to demonstrate freedom of navigation in Persian Gulf waters. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9615)
US officials advocate extending the naval blockade and economic pressure campaign against Iran rather than immediate military action. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/9610)
